subject: Trust portal access & SOC 2 Type II timeline for Acme Health
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.ai>
To: Patrick O'Neill <patrick@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 25 Jun 2026 14:10:00 -0700
Subject: Follow-up & doc request — SOC 2 Type II + trust portal access

Hi Patrick —

Thanks again for taking the call today. Quick recap and next steps so we have alignment: 

- Recap: demo of Redwood Dedicated, discussed HIPAA scope for Protected Health Information (PHI), and data flow boundaries (ingestion at customer edge, no storage on shared tenancy).
- Compliance ask: you flagged SOC 2 Type II evidence, a bridge letter for in-flight coverage, and a vendor security questionnaire (we heard you'll be sending a VSQ).
- Next steps (our side):
  1) Share SOC 2 Type II summary + trust portal access (we can grant read-only one-time access).
  2) Provide a signed bridge letter template for legal to review.
  3) Start the vendor security questionnaire — if you send the doc we can assign a point person.

Action items for Acme Health: please loop in the security and legal contacts for access and confirm who will own the VSQ. If easier, reply to this thread with security@acmehealth.com and legal@acmehealth.com and we'll add them to the portal invite.

Attached: Redwood-Security-Overview.pdf (high-level controls), SOC2-TypeII-Summary.txt (summary of scope and coverage periods).

We aim to get the portal invite + bridge letter back to you within 48 business hours after we have the security contact. 

Best,

Jordan Blake
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jordan@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0182

Attachments: Redwood-Security-Overview.pdf; SOC2-TypeII-Summary.txt
From: Patrick O'Neill <patrick@acmehealth.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.ai>
Cc: Acme Health Security <security@acmehealth.com>, Acme Health Legal <legal@acmehealth.com>
Date: Fri, 26 Jun 2026 09:05:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Follow-up & doc request — SOC 2 Type II + trust portal access

Jordan —

Appreciate the clear recap. I'm looping in our security and legal teams (copied). A couple quick notes:

- Security will run the VSQ. I'll have them open the questionnaire in SecureVendorPortal; they usually ask vendors to provide a downloadable report or a temporary read-only portal link.
- Legal will want the bridge letter and any redaction guidance — our standard turnaround is 3–5 business days once we have the draft and the SOC report.
- Timeline: we're looking to complete vendor review by 07/08/2026 for this procurement window. If you can get the portal access and bridge letter to security@acmehealth.com today or early next week, that would be ideal.

Who should security@acmehealth.com expect the invite from? Also, do you require an NDA signed before providing access?

Thanks,
Patrick O'Neill
Head of Product, Acme Health
patrick@acmehealth.com | +1 (617) 555-2222
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 26 Jun 2026 12:30:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Follow-up & doc request — SOC 2 Type II + trust portal access

Jordan —

I can handle the trust portal invite and the bridge letter. Quick notes so we match Acme's expectations:

- Trust portal flow: I will create a one-time read-only access link (valid 72 hours) to the AWS-hosted TrustPortal instance. The link will include the following items: SOC 2 Type II report (redacted PII), control matrices, and endpoint architecture diagram.
- Bridge letter: we'll send a signed PDF (notarization not required) with the effective coverage period and an explicit note about HIPAA scoping for PHI (since they called that out).
- NDA: not required for the initial read-only portal access; standard practice is to require an NDA only for full-scan log exports or deeper forensic artifacts.
- VSQ support: ask them to send the questionnaire file (XLS or SecureVendorPortal link). We'll assign Ben to field the VSQ responses and Dev to confirm deployment topology if they need detailed answers.

I'll prepare the portal invite from trust@redwood.ai and target to send within 24 hours to security@acmehealth.com. Ben — can you block 1 hour next week for VSQ deep-dive if they request architecture questions? Dev — heads-up you may get a few infra questions.

Marissa Cole
Security Operations Lead | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai

Attachments: SOC2-TypeII-Summary.txt

Patrick / Acme security —

- One-time read-only link valid for 72 hours to download the SOC 2 Type II report (redacted as needed) and control artifacts.
- A signed bridge letter PDF for legal review (sample attached).
- Contact: marissa_cole@redwood.ai (Security Ops) and ben_carter@redwood.ai (VSQ lead).

Quick links: Trust portal request: https://trust.redwood.ai/portal/acmehealth-request-XYZ123 — if you run into any access issues please reply and we'll reissue.

Thanks — looking forward to keeping this moving.

Jordan Blake
